acquisition_review: Only the sixteen fixed unique TRAIN metadata objects are selected; protocol list exactly equals the pinned metadata items.
GCS request specifies each exact generation and requires the same x-goog-generation response, exact advertised byte size and base64 MD5.
Preserve raw bytes, response metadata, URL, UTC and SHA; no replacement after missing/changed/short objects.
Strict UTF8, CRLF then remaining CR to LF, Unicode-codepoint midpoint, suffix after first LF at or after midpoint or midpoint if none.
Tokenize the complete suffix jointly with the pinned native tokenizer, add_special=true, parse_special=false, no chat template; take first 768 IDs. Too-short input holds calibration.
trajectory_review: Modes B=3/C_old=5/D_old=6 are fixed, in that order, with the same per-book immutable 768-token prefix.
Every arm/book rollout constructs and frees a distinct llama context/KV; the source model is read-only and old seed preprocessing/models remain registry-bound.
Six native 128-token prefix calls precede at most 32 greedy non-EOG-fed decode states, smallest-ID ties and full-vocabulary finite checks; EOG is recorded and never fed or padded.
Only B prefix states enter the multiset; all actual B/C/D decode states enter without hit/error sampling or deduplication.
ledger_and_pool_review: Owned Up input/route IDs are detached; actual final live alpha is captured by the inherited native weighted callback.

Separate input and alpha ledgers join matching typed model/run/context/subrun/arm/decode/micro/layer/T/H/K/request/position/phase identity fields; differing record kinds and payload layouts are checked separately.
IDs, slots, finite values, bounds, exact state uniqueness and bidirectional ledger completeness are checked, including zero pilot masks.
Closed rows follow selected book order then B prefix/B decode/C decode/D decode and absolute position; expected states are checked for every book/arm/layer.
Every row has unit weight and typed provenance. Identical rows are retained. All arms of a book share one pg19train book group and are not treated as independent books.
Per-layer upper limit is 13824 new rows; collection does not query new off-route supervised targets or change any fitted model.
identity_and_resource_review: Seven current refresh sources still equal immutable rev002 snapshots and receipt; protocol, TRAIN metadata and generated receipt hashes match.
Registry loading validates approved manifests, old canonical weights, all eight old C/D models and explicit old preprocessing; refreshed fitting is not active in this phase.

Original source GGUF stat identity is checked against the pinned historical metadata before use and unchanged after collection; this is reuse of the existing identity, not a newly computed GGUF content hash.

Launcher requires eight distinct physical cores and inherited process affinity; CPU-only model, eight GGML/FMA/activation workers and separately limited exact-DGEMM BLAS caller retain strict RN/MXCSR checks.
Worker live canonical/fallback row and activation counters are collection overhead, not deployment-latency or 8GB-residency evidence.
actual_release_requires: Root independently verifies the final 127-dependency source closure.
Root verifies BIND_OLD_CAPTURE complete success and binds its exact receipt SHA into a separate COLLECT_REFRESH approval before acquisition or model contexts.
No current BIND outcomes or candidate payloads were inspected by this source-only review.
